lines.t: I think I should tell you all about this

As you know, the {{principal|cap}}'s body is
mostly artificial.

It was caused by an old accident, but I
don't know more than that.
"Cyborg" may sound strong to you, but
the reality is quite the opposite.

A mechanical body is very delicate, and
just keeping him alive is all he can
manage.
What I'm trying to say is, in short--

I understand that things are tough right
now, but

please don't let the {{principal|cap}} overdo it
any more.
